blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY – Four Sabrah ASCOD II light tanks have boosted the Philippine Army’s armored combat and security capability, with their delivery in Mindanao. Brig. Gen. Bernardo Taqueban, commander of the Army’s 2nd Mechanized Infantry “Magbalantay” Brigade based in this city, said the Sabrah light tanks arrived at the Philippine Ports Authority complex at 8 a.m. from Cavite. The Philippine Navy’s BRP Bacolod City delivered the military tanks. READ: Army deploys Sabrah tanks in Tarlac exercise “The Sabrah ASCOD II light tank delivers an unprecedented blend of lethal firepower, networked battlefield intelligence, and tactical mobility,” Taqueban said.
